headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: A drone struck the tanker Petro Dolphin at Sohar Anchorage in Oman, confirmed by UKMTO, a hit inside the Gulf of Oman transfer zone that carries Saudi workaround barrels, and a second drone hit the tanker Valthera in the strait. That fires the STS-zone tripwire: escalated war by Nov. 3 rises from 7% to 11% and war by Nov. 3 from 55% to 62%. Iran called the US reply on reopening Hormuz "insufficient," and the Houthis hit a second Saudi airport, in Dammam.

bets.cond: Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
Iran ends strait tolls and permits, or declares Hormuz open to all shipping
Iran offers a concrete cut in enrichment capacity, in text or on the record
